elements.description:
The app launcher: a grid button that opens a popover of the person's apps, as links, with pinned and recent apps,
groups, search and an optional footer link.

properties.name: apps
properties.description: The apps, in the order "All apps" lists them

properties.name: current
properties.description: The id of the app the person is in – its tile is marked

properties.name: pinned
properties.description: The ids of the pinned apps, in order – listed first, under "Pinned"

properties.name: recent
properties.description: The ids of recently used apps, most recent first – listed under "Recent" (pinned ones aren't repeated)

properties.name: pinnable
properties.description: Adds Edit pins, where each tile toggles its pin

properties.name: search
properties.description: The search field: "auto" shows it from `search-threshold` apps, "on" always, "off" never

properties.name: searchThreshold
properties.description: How many apps make "auto" show the search field

properties.name: columns
properties.description: The most columns of tiles; fewer when there isn't room

properties.name: layout
properties.description: "trigger" (default): the button that opens the panel; "panel": the panel inline, as a card

properties.name: open
properties.description: Whether the button's panel is open

properties.name: label
properties.description: The button's accessible name and the panel's title

properties.name: footerHref
properties.description: A link at the foot of the panel – "All apps" or "Manage apps" – shown when set

properties.name: loading
properties.description: The apps are being fetched: skeleton tiles show

properties.name: error
properties.description: Fetching the apps failed: this message shows, with Retry

properties.name: emptyText
properties.description: Shown when there are no apps

properties.name: labels
properties.description: Replaces any of the panel's words (Pinned, Recent, Search apps, Edit pins…)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-app-select
events.description: A tile was picked with a plain click or Enter; detail `{ id, app }`. Cancelable: preventDefault() stops the link being followed (route in the app instead)

events.name: tc-pin-change
events.description: A pin was toggled while editing pins; detail `{ id, pinned, pins }` (`pins` as they'd be afterwards). Cancelable: preventDefault() and the app updates `pinned`

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: The panel is opening or closing; detail `{ open }`. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps it as it is

events.name: tc-retry
events.description: Retry was chosen after an error – the app loads the apps again

functions.name: appMatch
functions.description: How well an app matches a search: 0 none; 4 the name starts with it, 3 a word in the name does, 2 the name has it, 1 a keyword, the group or (from three letters) the description has a word starting with it

props.name: pinned
props.description: The pinned app ids, in order. Controlled when defined: a pin toggle only reports, and you update the list

props.name: defaultPinned
props.description: The pinned app ids when uncontrolled – the component applies pin toggles itself

props.name: onPinnedChange
props.description: Called with the pinned ids as they are after a pin toggle

props.name: onSelect
props.description: An app was picked with a plain click or Enter; return false to stop its link being followed (route yourself)

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the panel is open. Controlled when defined

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the panel starts open when uncontrolled

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry was chosen after `error` – load the apps again

changelog: **`tc-app-picker`:** the app launcher. - **Sections:** Pinned, Recent and All apps, or your own groups. - **Finding and opening:** search; real links; arrow keys across the grid. - **Pins and states:** an "Edit pins" mode, loading and error states, and an inline panel layout.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: Popover API
features.without: Lists open fixed to the window instead of in the top layer, so a clipping ancestor or a modal can cover them.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
